metadata.subject: Maths

layout.page1: intro (header, method, common mistakes, worked example, visual aid)
layout.writingSpace: none — pupils work in separate workbooks

metadata.note: Base canonical version. No SEND overlay applied.

intro.note: Answer each question in your workbook. Show your working.
commonMistakes: Writing d + n instead of dn.
Confusing term number with term value.
Not checking that n is a positive whole number.
intro.visualAid: The arcs between terms show the constant difference (+4 each step). The rule 4n − 1 gives the value of the term in position n.

questions.content: Write the next two terms: a) 2, 5, 8, 11, …  b) 20, 17, 14, …
Find d and the nth term: a) 4, 6, 8, 10, …  b) 1, 5, 9, 13, …
nth term = 4n − 1. a) 10th term?  b) 20th term?  c) Which term is 51?
Is the number in the sequence? a) 100 in 3n + 1?  b) 50 in 4n − 2?  c) 30 in 5n + 2?
Theatre: row 1 = 15 seats, row 2 = 18, row 3 = 21. a) Rule for row n. b) Seats in row 10.
nth term = 6n − 4. a) First three terms. b) 50th term. c) Show 201 is not a term.
A: 4n+1, B: 3n+7. a) First five terms of each. b) Common value? c) Solve 4n+1 = 3n+7 and explain.
